SS-CODEX.Purpose: Expose FLI Core and the canonical skill inside OpenAI Codex through its native hooks, lifecycle, and context surfaces.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Physical owner: `integrations/codex`; synchronous successful Bash `PostToolUse` read trigger.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Context delivery via native `additionalContext`; diagnostics via `systemMessage`; lifecycle via SessionStart + PostCompact.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Skill delivery: plugin `skills/` catalog from canonical `packages/skills`.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: FLI declaration parsing, selector Resolution, graph-boundary inference, ontology semantics.

Principles.PRIN-001: The adapter remains thin regardless of implementation language.
Principles.PRIN-002: Shell read classification is a local Rust/native exception because the authoritative upstream implementation is Rust; classification is consumed from the shared `packages/read-classifier` and owns read classification only.
Principles.PRIN-003: Canonical skill remains harness-independent; Codex receives package-time exact copies.

Requirements.REQ-001: Only classifier-confirmed reliable reads become Core file observations; reads inside the plugin's own installation subtree are internal and never FLI events.
Requirements.REQ-002: Pinned wire contract: shell `PostToolUse` `tool_input` is exactly `{"command": "..."}` and hook input carries the session `cwd`; a relative read resolves against that cwd — no suffix/unique-candidate heuristics; absolute reads pass through unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-003: DeliveryScope == `session_id + (agent_id | __main__)`; `PostCompact` resets matching context; SessionStart startup|clear resets session, resume preserves, compact resets main context.
Requirements.REQ-004: SessionStart performs reset/preserve plus a concise FLI-active status only; no FLI semantic `additionalContext`; FLI guidance routes through the native skill catalog.
Requirements.REQ-005: Core subprocess exceeding the adapter's bounded budget is terminated with a user-visible internal diagnostic before the harness hook deadline.
Requirements.REQ-006: Installation triggers no automatic Initialization and no Audit schedule; the package is self-contained for the supported runtime.
